fullPassage: We are now at a point of unprecedented genetic, cultural, and environmental power as a species, and we are linked to nearly every other person on Earth. We are embodied individuals trapped within limited time, but we are also networked data streams, memories, and influencers, and part of a grander humanity. Our decisions today have far-reaching impacts that place a responsibility on us to become good ancestors, to take the long view and time travel forward to imagine the well-being of billions of people whose lives will be lived in the world we are currently making. Centuries ago, leaders of the native North American Iroquois people created "seven generation stewardship," instructing people to consider the impact of every decision on their children, seven generations into the future. In the precious few decades that Earth is ours, while we enjoy the gardens planted by our ancestors, we must not steal the shade from our descendants.

In the precious few decades that Earth is ④<u>our</u>, we must not steal the shade from our descendants.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ our → ours: be동사 보어로 소유대명사 필요.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ our: Earth is ours(소유대명사)
✅ ① trapped: 수동 후치수식
✅ ② place: impacts(복수) + place
✅ ③ instructing: 분사구문
det.tip: 소유격 our + 명사 / be동사 + ours(소유대명사)

det.korean: ② short(짧은)는 원문 long(긴)의 반의어. '단기적 시각'이 아니라 '장기적 시각'을 취하라.
det.analysis:
❌ ② short: 원문 long → take the long view

✅ ③ descendants: 원문 일치
✅ ④ precious: 원문 일치
det.tip: take the long view(장기적 시각) ↔ take the short view(단기적 시각)

❌ ① preserve(보존): 빼앗는 것이 아닌 보존
❌ ② share(공유): 경고 문맥과 안 맞음
❌ ③ protect(보호): 경고 문맥과 안 맞음

후손에게 그늘진 땅을 물려줘서는 안 된다

✅ ② 미래 세대 혜택 보호: shade = 비유(후대의 혜택)
❌ ① 당장 개선: 즉각적 행동이 아닌 장기적 시각
❌ ③ 그늘진 땅: 직역, 비유 아님
❌ ④ 나무 벌목: 직역, 핵심 아님
det.tip:
비유: shade = 후대가 누릴 혜택/유산
steal the shade = 그 혜택을 빼앗다

questions.passage: We are now at a point of unprecedented genetic, cultural, and environmental power as a species, and we are linked to nearly every other person on Earth. We are embodied individuals trapped within limited time, but we are also networked data streams, memories, and influencers, and part of a grander humanity. Our decisions today have far-reaching impacts that place a responsibility on us to become good ancestors, to take the long view and time travel forward to imagine the well-being of billions of people whose lives will be lived in the world we are currently making. Centuries ago, leaders of the native North American Iroquois people created "seven generation stewardship," instructing people to consider the impact of every decision on their children, seven generations into the future. In the precious few decades that Earth is ours, while ____, we must not steal the shade from our descendants.
